subject: Git Connect inquiry — integration questions & demo scheduling
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@octoops.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Git Connect + demo

Hi Vanessa,

I signed up for Redwood via the self-serve flow this morning and my team at OctoOps is particularly interested in the Git Connect integration. A few quick questions before we lock in a demo:

- Does Redwood support access to private repos only via a bot account, or can we use existing org-level OAuth apps?
- Any limitations on webhook scopes (e.g., pull_request, push, issue comments)?
- We run a hybrid setup (cloud + on-prem build runners) — is Private deployment required for that?

Would love a 30–45 minute demo this week if possible. Our timezone is PDT (San Francisco), availability generally 11am–3pm PT after Tuesday.

Thanks,
Samir Kapoor
Head of Platform & Integrations
OctoOps
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@octoops.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Git Connect + demo

Hi Samir — great to meet you and welcome!

Thanks for the context. I can absolutely set up a focused 30-minute demo to walk through Git Connect and answer those exact questions. A few quick points up front:

- Repo access: we support both bot accounts (recommended for least-privilege) and org-level OAuth apps; we can show the permissions matrix during the demo.
- Webhooks: standard events (push, pull_request, issue_comment) are supported; we'll cover how to scope them and minimize noise.
- Hybrid runs: Private deployment is recommended for air-gapped runners, but many teams use Redwood Dedicated with VPC peering for hybrid CI/CD — we can discuss tradeoffs.

Proposed 30-min slots (PDT):
- Tue 2027-06-08 11:00–11:30
- Tue 2027-06-08 13:00–13:30
- Wed 2027-06-09 14:00–14:30

If none of those work, tell me 2 windows that do and I will match. I attached a short one-pager on Git Connect to this thread so you can skim before the call.

Also: would you be able to share the approximate scale (number of repos, average PRs/day) and whether you need audit/log exports to a customer-managed store? That will help us bring the right level of detail.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
SR. SDR, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

Subject: Confirmed: Git Connect demo (Tue 2027-06-08 13:00 PT)

Hi Samir — confirmed for Tue 2027-06-08 13:00–13:30 PT. Invited Ben (Solutions) and Marcus (Product) so we can cover both security and deployment options.

Short answers to your prep questions:
- Webhook setup: we typically ask for a repo-level service account with repo:admin for initial setup to create webhooks and set permissions, but the bot approach minimizes ongoing privileges. We’ll show both flows and a checklist to hand off to security.
- OAuth vs bot: org-level OAuth can be more convenient but may grant broader scopes; bot accounts are recommended if you need least-privilege and tighter audit trails. We’ll walk through the permissions matrix.

Attached: mutual action plan (MAP) with suggested milestones and a short checklist you can share with security. Also a calendar invite link — accept when convenient.

Looking forward to it.

Vanessa Ortiz
SR. SDR, Redwood Inference
